audit_items.proof_trace: All five balance-changing entry point families (deposit, withdraw_as_coin, borrow, repay_on_behalf, and all three liquidation variants via post_liquidation) call miner.update_obligation_reward_manager immediately after the corresponding handle_* internal call, passing the post-operation balance as new_share. The update order in change_obligation_reward_manager_share first settles accumulated rewards with the old share (via cumulative index), then sets the new share, preventing any stale-index exploitation.
